pain: Operators need safe mapping forms and scoped credential read views.
done_when: Repository mapping edits use revision preconditions, impact review and fresh readback after conflicts or uncertain outcomes without automatic mutation replay.
Credential reads require trusted Identity Bindings and exact owner, Project and environment grants; catalog administration grants no credential rights.
Missing sources, denied access and empty authorized inventories remain distinct; no secret values or credential writes are exposed.
Browser qualification covers keyboard/mobile use, reload, scoped detail views and concurrent mapping changes.

out_of_scope: Live credentials and Access policy changes
